reason: The $5 million request falls within the disclosed Freddie Mac Conventional Small range of $2 million to $10 million per the April 15, 2026 launch announcement (freddie-transition). However, being within the disclosed amount range establishes only size eligibility — not full program eligibility and not approval. The Freddie Mac source explicitly notes that the announcement does not state a complete set of current underwriting criteria or promise approval, so property type, occupancy/stabilization, LTV, DSCR, sponsor, market, and other underwriting requirements for Conventional Small are not verified in this evidence packet. The Fannie Mae term sheet (fannie-conventional) is a separate program and does not govern Freddie Mac Conventional Small eligibility. No actual approval evidence is present.
